intro: A starter list, meant to be rewritten by each family. Every expectation is in video-camera terms — if you filmed it being met, this is what you'd see. Consequences touch privileges only, never freedoms already transferred.

expectations.expectation: Schoolwork is turned in by its due date; missing work appears on no more than the rare occasion, and when it does, you're the one who tells us.
expectations.consequence: Weeknight screen privileges pause until the missing work is in.

expectations.expectation: Your assigned family jobs are done by the agreed time each day without reminders on camera — the dishwasher is empty, the trash is out.
expectations.consequence: Undone jobs get done before any outing or ride from us happens.

expectations.expectation: You are inside the house by the agreed time, and if something changes, we hear from you before the deadline, not after.
expectations.consequence: The next outing's window shrinks by the amount you were late.

expectations.expectation: Before you go somewhere new, we know where, with whom, and when you'll be back — a text is fine.
expectations.consequence: The next trip out requires a confirmed plan in advance.

expectations.expectation: You are at family dinner and family events we've named as mandatory, present and phone-free.
expectations.consequence: A missed mandatory event is repaid with a family hour you plan.

expectations.expectation: Disagreement happens at conversation volume, without name-calling, at any hour; anyone can call a pause and return to it later.
expectations.consequence: A blown-up conversation resumes only after a written or spoken repair.
